entities.label: Tall wide jungle canopy — densely packed green cubes
entities.looks_like: Thick trunk with large wide green canopy boxes stacked high, denser than scattered oaks

entities.label: Vines hanging on trunks or canopy — jungle signature flora
entities.looks_like: Vertical green vine boxes or strands on tree sides, not just floor bushes

entities.label: Cocoa on trunks, melon patches, or bamboo shoots
entities.looks_like: Brown cocoa pods on wood, green melon cubes on the floor, or vertical bamboo stalks

entities.label: Bright lush-green foliage tint — not spruce dark green or desert tan
entities.looks_like: Canopy/leaf color in vivid tropical green on jungle cells

entities.label: Inland jungle pond — dark still water surface
entities.looks_like: Dark green/brown water voxels or plane at pond level inside jungle, not flowing river cyan

entities.label: Waterfall — vertical cascade of water voxels
entities.looks_like: Vertical column or stack of cyan/white water boxes dropping height

entities.label: Persistent jungle rain shafts falling downward
entities.looks_like: Blue/white elongated rain particles over jungle coordinates with dominant downward motion

entities.label: Rising mist after rain over wet canopy
entities.looks_like: Pale particles with upward or near-zero drift over jungle after/during rain

entities.label: Edge grazers (deer class) grounded in jungle
entities.looks_like: Quadruped voxels at jungle edge cells with terrain-height grounding

entities.label: Canopy birds with subtle hover or perch motion
entities.looks_like: Small bird voxels with y oscillation, rotation, or perch animation in jungle canopy zone

must_not_present.label: Snow, blizzard, or pine forest as jungle flora
Cactus or sandstorm as the jungle
Pink flowering grove canopy as jungle
